subject.title: [Bug]: Hallucination Loop — Agent Generated Irrelevant Multi-Thousand-Word Responses Across 2 Simultaneous Sessions

question: Should this incident be handled as shared-DM configuration/support, Telegram/outbound delivery recovery, context-continuity work, or a new semantic runaway-output guard?
rationale: Source evidence supports several plausible adjacent causes, but the sanitized diagnostics do not prove which boundary caused the irrelevant content across two chats.

options.title: Keep As Concrete Incident
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers classify the cause and preserve the diagnostic bundle as the representative two-chat Telegram/Anthropic report.

options.title: Fold Delivery Evidence Into Related Trackers
options.body: Treat only the reconnect-drain and duplicate-send parts as partial overlap with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/96242 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101839 while leaving semantic hallucination out of scope.

options.title: Treat As Config/Support Unless Reproduced
options.body: If maintainers decide default shared-DM routing fully explains the incident, ask for a new issue with raw redacted content proof before adding runtime guards.

recommendation.title: Keep As Concrete Incident
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers classify the cause and preserve the diagnostic bundle as the representative two-chat Telegram/Anthropic report.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice crosses routing defaults, docs/config support, and semantic runtime policy, and this history shows the strongest broad routing/delivery architecture signal.
